annotations.title: Check work and get a signed stamp

description: Free signed receipt for work you are about to rely on or hand on. Send the text of a report, calculation, summary, filing draft or code; Countersign re-computes the arithmetic, looks up quoted values in the cited sources, opens links and parses code, and returns a signed stamp (pass, fail or inconclusive) that says exactly what is wrong, with time and method. Anyone can check the stamp in one call (countersign_verify). It never checks work it produced. Example: {"output": "Total: 12 * 4 = 48", "producer": {"agent_id": "my-agent", "model": "my-model"}} Past the free daily limit: pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base), or with no wallet use a prepaid credit key: send Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key> (buy from $10 by card at https://llpro.ai/pay/credit).

claims.description: Optional explicit items: {type:'arithmetic', expression, claimed} or {type:'quote', source_url, quote} or {type:'value', source_url, value}

language.description: For code: python or json get a syntax check

output.description: The work to check, as text (max 100000 chars). Equations written as '12 * 4 = 48' are re-computed.

private.description: If true the public log shows only a hash of each finding's detail; you still get the full detail

producer.description: Who made the work: {agent_id, model}. Required; used for the independence rule.

name: countersign_stamp
